title: Fenchel Tilting: Weighted Correction for Efficient Finetuning of Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.40030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting a pretrained generative model to an arbitrary preference expressed as a utility function underlies reward alignment, guided design, and constraint satisfaction, enabling diverse applications. Existing fine-tuning methods trade off generality against computational cost: they either restrict the family class of supported preferences to keep optimization simple or preserve generality at the expense of efficiency. We introduce Fenchel Tilt Flow Control (FTFC), which decouples utility optimization from generative-model fitting. FTFC first optimizes for a target distribution by jointly fitting an effective reward and density-ratio weights on pretrained samples. Method combines the utility's variational structure with Fenchel duality, supporting general $f$-divergence penalties that determine how rewards are transformed into an distribution-correction weights. These weights are then frozen and used to modify a diffusion or flow model

translated_title: Fenchel 倾斜：用于生成模型高效微调的加权校正方法
translated_abstract: 将预训练生成模型适配到以效用函数表达的任意偏好，是奖励对齐、引导设计与约束满足等应用的基础，能够支持多样化的应用场景。现有的微调方法在通用性与计算成本之间进行权衡：它们要么通过限制所支持偏好的函数类别来简化优化，要么以牺牲效率为代价来保留通用性。我们提出了 Fenchel 倾斜流控制，该方法将效用优化与生成模型拟合解耦。FTFC 首先在预训练样本上联合拟合有效奖励与密度比权重，从而优化目标分布。该方法将效用的变分结构与 Fenchel 对偶相结合，支持一般的 f-散度惩罚项，该惩罚项决定了奖励如何被转换为分布校正权重。这些权重随后被冻结，并用于修改扩散模型或流模型。
tldr: 提出 FTFC 方法，借助 Fenchel 对偶在预训练样本上联合拟合有效奖励与密度比权重，将效用优化与生成模型拟合解耦，再以冻结权重的方式高效微调扩散或流生成模型。
en_tdlr: FTFC decouples utility optimization from generative-model fitting by jointly fitting an effective reward and density-ratio weights via Fenchel duality, then freezes these weights to efficiently finetune diffusion or flow models.
